Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Attached is our standard security intake (Cora_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). A few items we need resolved before legal will sign the Order Form:

- Confirmation of SOC 2 Type II coverage and date range you will provide evidence for (our audit covers 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31).
- Penetration test window options — ideally in the first two weeks of November; please confirm blackout dates and staging access requirements.
- Clarify whether on-site inspections are permitted under your audit-rights language (we typically expect remote evidence first).

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Subject: Re: Security exhibit questionnaire + proposed pen test window

Hi Alice — thanks for sending this over and for the context.

High-level plan from our side:
1) SOC 2: we can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-31 (we'll attach the redacted report).
2) Pen test: proposing a controlled window 2026-11-15 through 2026-11-19 for external vendor testing against staging. Details below.
3) On-site inspection / audit rights: we prefer to limit to remote evidence collection and, where needed, a secure remote session. If Cora requires physical inspection, legal has asked for scoping language and notice windows.

I've attached a working draft of the security exhibit (Redwood_Security_Exhibit_Draft_v3.docx) with inline comments to address: limited inspection language, a defined evidence cadence (weekly evidence bundle during ramp + monthly exports thereafter), and explicit staging access instructions (IP whitelist, read-only service accounts, TTL for credentials).

Requested next steps:
- Laura (Legal) to review the proposed redlines in the draft (I copied her).
- Cora to confirm whether the pen-test vendor needs access to production or if staging-only is acceptable.
- Agree on evidence delivery cadence and owner (we suggest a shared Drive folder and a weekly evidence digest).

We will also propose a modest change to the inspection clause: replace open-ended "on-site inspection" with "reasonable remote evidence review; on-site only by mutual written agreement and limited to non-production replicas." That avoids last-minute travel while preserving Cora's right to audit with proper notice.

Thanks — I can join a call tomorrow afternoon if that's easiest.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

On Sat, Oct 30, 2026 at 10:48 AM PDT Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alice — thanks for sending this over and for the context.
> 
> High-level plan from our side:
> 1) SOC 2: we can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-31 (we'll attach the redacted report).
> 2) Pen test: proposing a controlled window 2026-11-15 through 2026-11-19 for external vendor testing against staging.

Thanks Soojin — quick legal notes after a first pass on the exhibit draft:

- Inspection clause: I support narrowing to remote evidence review. Please change the proposed text to: "Customer may request remote evidence review with at least 15 business days' notice. Any in-person inspection requires mutual written agreement and reimbursement of documented Redwood travel costs." This preserves their right while protecting us operationally.

- Pen test: add express limits that testing must not degrade service (max load limits), and require coordination through our security ops mailbox. Also require a signed Rules of Engagement (ROE) and proof of vendor insurance before start.

- SOC 2 evidence: we'll provide the redacted report, plus a scoped set of control narratives and logs for the audit period. We should avoid committing to live-log exports beyond what we already provide (exported logs on request via secure share is ok).

- Data retention / audit artifacts: suggest we add a 12-month retention baseline for evidence artifacts post-engagement; anything older will be handled by a formal request with justification.

I'll prepare tracked-change language for the exhibit and the order form — I'll upload the redline later today. Priyom, can you confirm whether engineering can support the pen-test staging window and the proposed credential TTL?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Alice — appreciate the quick turn here. Quick status and concrete asks to keep us aligned: 

1) SOC 2: attached redacted report and control narratives will be uploaded to the shared Drive by EOD Monday (link below). Expected contents: redacted Type II report, control narratives for access control and change management, sample log exports for Oct 2026.

2) Pen test: engineering confirmed staging window 2026-11-15 through 2026-11-19. Priyom will be the engineering owner and will coordinate the ROE.
   - Engineering asks: vendor to use only staging endpoints, adhere to ROE, and cap simulated load to the agreed thresholds.
   - Credentials will be time-limited (72-hour TTL) and issued via our secure vault; IP whitelist will be required.

3) Inspection language: Laura uploaded tracked changes with the remote-first language and the 15-business-day notice. Laura: can you send the docx redline link once uploaded?

4) Evidence cadence: proposed weekly digest during onboarding (every Friday) containing: artifact index, redacted logs, and configuration snapshots. Ongoing: monthly exports for 6 months post-deployment, then on-request. We will create a shared Drive folder and add Cora security users with viewer access.

Action items / owners:
- Priyom (engineering) — ROE & credential TTL config; confirm by 2026-11-05.
- Laura (legal) — finalize tracked redline for security exhibit and Order Form language; send by 2026-11-06.
- Soojin (security) — upload SOC 2 redaction + narratives to Drive; notify Cora when available.
- Alice (Cora) — confirm vendor/staging requirement and whether Cora needs an in-person option (yes/no) by 2026-11-06.

Drive evidence folder (private): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_shared_evidence

If this timeline works, we'll incorporate the final redlines into the Order Form and send to your procurement team for signature. Thanks all — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

— Soojin
